title: From Vajrayana Tara to Bengali Baul: A Computational Study of Lexical Transmission Across Buddhist, Shakta, and Vaishnava Traditions in Bengal
reasoning: The paper performs a computational lexical analysis to evaluate the historical relationship, transmission, and syncretism between several religious and spiritual traditions, including Vajrayana Buddhism, Shakta Tantra, Vaishnavism, and the Baul tradition.
